title: Discovery 5 — the breaker is LIVE for this pair (no credentials)
description: Any single Central Bank can halt the Hub AMM for a pair; restarting it takes two. Check this before swapping: a halted breaker makes the swap fail with 422 CIRCUIT_BREAKER_HALTED.
notes: Gateway: any. ALWAYS pass pair. The breaker is per pair and omitting the parameter does not report 'the network' — the handler substitutes the literal BRL-USD, which on most deployments is not a registered pair at all, so an omitted parameter can return a healthy-looking LIVE for a pair nobody trades. Note also that a LIVE answer is not proof no peer has halted: when the chain cannot be read the gateway silently falls back to its local projection, and to LIVE when it has no record. The pair parameter is undeclared upstream; both it and the response shape come from the delivered handler.
